latexgenOrtWebgpu.runtime: ONNX Runtime Web WebGPU EP (LatexGen docs/benchmarks.md: 'overhead-bound, stays on CPU')

floor.reasoning: A dispatch + 4-byte readback is 0.1 ms queued; every activation tensor crossing the graph boundary costs ~0.4 ms per 384 KiB in and out and is not amortised by queuing, so the four full-length caches cost 1.6 ms per dispatch, divided by the k=16 unrolled steps. The remaining ~0.55 ms per step is ~85 WebNN ops (91 Core ML ops) at 6-7 us of per-op launch overhead each; the compiled plan puts every op on the GPU and the cache-length sweep (S=128: -10%) shows bytes are not the bound. Fewer ops per step is the only lever left.
